title: Rathi Steel And Power Ltd. v. M.D. PVVNL
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pritinker Diwaker, J.; Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following Dev Prayag Paper Mill (21.3.2017).
headnote: Challenge to an additional-security demand and to clause 4.20(1) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires Section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003, dismissed in terms of this Court’s 21.3.2017 judgment in Dev Prayag Paper Mill, which had already dismissed identical petitions.
facts: Rathi Steel and Power Ltd. challenged a demand for additional security for electricity supply, with a warning that non-payment within the stipulated period would invite action in accordance with law. They also attacked clause (1) of paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, insofar as the consumer’s option depends on the licensee providing a choice, as ultra vires Section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003. Counsel stated that identical petitions had already been dismissed and that the lead judgment was pending in the Supreme Court.

holding_units.topic: additional security; consumer option under clause 4.20(1)
holding_units.holding: The writ petition, including the challenge to clause 4.20(1) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires Section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003, is dismissed in terms of the judgment dated 21.3.2017 in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) v. State of U.P. (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016), which had already dismissed identical additional-security matters.
